title: High-ranking NASA official tells Chris he's a huge fan at the Capitol Hill Club
summary: Chris Bledsoe tells of High-ranking NASA official tells Chris he's a huge fan at the Capitol Hill Club, about 2025 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this guy walks up and he's he gives me a big hug he said Chris I'm a huge fan

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs appear around him and who says NASA has taken an interest in him, describes an evening in 2025 at the Capitol Hill Club, a private club close to the US Congress in Washington. He says a high-ranking NASA official walked up, gave him a big hug and told him, "Chris, I'm a huge fan." He tells it as a sign that people inside the US space agency take his experiences seriously.
